note: Plain-language names + general (ancestry-agnostic) reference bands, used to make every number understandable and to replace 'no reference for your cohort' with a meaningful category when population data is thin. Bands for shape indices/angles are descriptive anthropology, not ideals.

canthal_tilt.what: whether your outer eye corners sit higher or lower than the inner corners
canthal_tilt.meaning: a stable feature of your eye shape — nothing to act on.

intercanthal_width.what: how far apart your eyes are

fifth_intercanthal.what: your inner-eye gap compared to the width of one eye

eye_fissure_length.what: how long each eye opening is

nasal_height.what: from the bridge to the base of your nose

nasal_index.what: nose width relative to its length
nasal_index.meaning: varies a lot by ancestry; purely descriptive.

facial_height.what: from the bridge of your nose to your chin

facial_index.what: face length relative to face width
facial_index.meaning: describes overall face shape; no shape is better.

third_upper.what: the top third of your face
third_upper.meaning: unreliable from a photo — the camera can't see your hairline.

fwhr.what: how wide your face is relative to its upper height

ipd.what: the distance between your pupils (used to calibrate the ruler)

pigment_first.summary: Your skin's main pattern is pigment-first — uneven tone, sun spots, and melasma show up before deep wrinkles.
pigment_first.prevent: PIH prevention is higher-leverage than treatment here: treat breakouts early, don't pick or squeeze, and keep daily sunscreen non-negotiable — UV deepens and prolongs every mark.

photoaging_first.summary: Your skin's main pattern is photoaging-first — fine lines, redness, and sun damage tend to lead.

east_asian: Wrinkles typically lag ~a decade in East Asian skin — tone evenness, not fine lines, is your highest-leverage axis. Don't over-index on lines.
East Asian skin tends to be drier (lower natural moisturizing factor) and more reactive — ramp actives slowly, patch-test new products, and pair them with a barrier moisturizer.
